pharmacology.text: Casopitant (INN), former tentative trade names Rezonic (U.S.) and Zunrisa (Europe), is an NK1 receptor antagonist which was undergoing research for the treatment of chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting.

uses.text: Casopitant (INN), former tentative trade names Rezonic (U.S.) and Zunrisa (Europe), is an NK1 receptor antagonist which was undergoing research for the treatment of chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting. It was under development by GlaxoSmithKline. In July 2008, the company filed a marketing authorisation application with the European Medicines Agency.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Related NK1 blockers used for nausea, such as aprepitant, commonly cause tiredness, hiccups, constipation and headache.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知不多。用於止吐的同類 NK1 阻斷劑，例如阿瑞匹坦，常見作用有疲倦、打嗝、便秘與頭痛。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知不多。用于止吐的同类 NK1 阻断剂，例如阿瑞匹坦，常见作用有疲倦、打嗝、便秘与头痛。

fact.en: NK1 blockers like casopitant stop the action of substance P, a nerve messenger found in 1931. The P is usually said to stand for the powder, or preparation, it was first extracted as.
fact.zh: 像卡索匹坦這樣的 NK1 阻斷劑，會阻止 P 物質的作用。P 物質是在 1931 年發現的神經傳導物質，一般認為 P 代表它最初被萃取出來時的粉末或製劑（preparation）。
fact.zhHans: 像卡索匹坦这样的 NK1 阻断剂，会阻止 P 物质的作用。P 物质是在 1931 年发现的神经传导物质，一般认为 P 代表它最初被萃取出来时的粉末或制剂（preparation）。
